FrostHollow_Text_Npc0.en: It is always winter in here. The\nice remembers everything.
FrostHollow_Text_Npc0.fr: Il fait toujours hiver ici. La\nglace se souvient de tout.

FrostHollow_Text_Npc1.en: SNEASEL steal what they can. Keep\nyour berries close.
FrostHollow_Text_Npc1.fr: FARFURET vole ce qu'il peut. Garde\ntes baies près de toi.

FrostHollow_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: I study how ice melts. Two BURN\nHEALs would help my tests.
FrostHollow_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: J'étudie la fonte de la glace. Deux\nANTI-BRÛLE aideraient mes tests.

FrostHollow_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
FrostHollow_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

FrostHollow_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

FrostHollow_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
